verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a quickstart script that spins up a demo AI Gateway instance almost instantly (docs-2). That could work as an isolated test environment, but nothing describes a dedicated sandbox, test mode or separation from production data and traffic. Missing for 10: a documented sandbox or test environment, guidance on isolating test traffic and data from production, mock or test LLM provider endpoints, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
